PLAN "Cycle-Aware 12-Week Strength for Severe Dysmenorrhea"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build strength while respecting flow restrictions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Intro & Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength - Lower (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Strength - Upper (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning - Low Intensity (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 20x1..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength - Lower (Flow days allowed: modified)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Strength - Upper (Flow days allowed: modified)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility & Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 3x10..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          child_pose 3x1..1 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength - Lower (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Strength - Upper (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Conditioning - Low Impact":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 20x1..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Flow Window - Gentle Strength (Cycle days 1-3)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band_pull_apart 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Flow Window - Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Flow Window - Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5..5 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          gentle_walk 1x20..20 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength - Lower (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Strength - Upper (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning - Low Impact":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 12x1..1 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength - Lower (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Strength - Upper (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Flow Window - Reduced Intensity Strength (Cycle days 1-3)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Flow Window - Core & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow Window - Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5..5 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength - Lower (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3..5 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Strength - Upper (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..5 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning - Low Impact":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 15x1..1 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Intensify & Peak" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength - Lower (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3..4 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5..7 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Strength - Upper (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..4 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x4..6 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4..6 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Conditioning - Low Impact":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 18x1..1 rpe 7.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Flow Window - Protective Strength (Cycle days 1-3)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Flow Window - Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Flow Window - Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5..5 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Strength - Lower (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x2..3 rpe 9..9.5 rest 180 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x3..4 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x4..6 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Strength - Upper (Follicular/Luteal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x2..3 rpe 9..9.5 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x3..5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 4x3..5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning - Low Impact":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 20x1..1 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload - Whole Week (includes Flow)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload - Upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Deload - Mobility & Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5..5 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
